reason: I have written every bill in my register for years and I count the drawer myself every night, so I already know what should be there. ₹5,000 down plus getting 8 stylists to change how they bill in the middle of a busy week is a headache I don't need for something that already works.
objection: My stylists will stop using the app within a couple of weeks, the register will come back, and I'll have paid to run two systems. And I don't want my customers' details sitting on some company's server.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it running in another busy Bhubaneswar salon my size for a few months, with the owner telling me it caught cash going missing that his register didn't.
